packages.title: ONS Energy use: total — scope and status QA
facts: The ONS Energy use: total dataset was released on 5 June 2026 and covers 1990 to 2024.
It covers direct UK energy use from fossil fuels and other sources and reallocates use by 21 SIC sections.
ONS provides previous versions and identifies scheduled updates or revisions.
Energy use is activity data and is not itself greenhouse-gas emissions.
No parcel greenhouse-gas value is inferred from national or industry energy-use data.

packages.title: ONS Energy use: by industry, source and fuel — scope and status QA
facts: The ONS energy-use dataset released on 5 June 2026 covers 1990 to 2024.
It provides energy use by around 130 SIC groups, around 80 activity sources and around 20 fuels.
Sources include industrial and domestic combustion, aircraft and road transport.
Fuel or energy-use activity must remain distinct from emissions unless an explicit accepted conversion model is applied.
No property-level emissions observation is created by the energy-use table.

packages.title: ONS Energy use: fossil fuels by fuel type — scope and status QA
facts: The ONS fossil-fuel-use dataset was released on 5 June 2026 and covers 1990 to 2024.
It reports UK fuel use by types including coal, natural gas, petrol, diesel, fuel oil, gas oil and aviation fuel.
The table excludes biofuels and waste.
Fuel-use quantities are activity measures and are not direct greenhouse-gas measurements.
No parcel emissions value is inferred from national fossil-fuel-use totals.

packages.title: ONS Estimates of quarterly greenhouse gas emissions — scope and status QA
facts: ONS released estimates of quarterly greenhouse-gas emissions on 5 February 2026.
The dataset uses a Chow-Lin regression-based temporal disaggregation method to estimate quarterly emissions.
The latest listed edition covers quarter 3 of 2025.
Modelled quarterly estimates must remain distinct from directly observed physical measurements.
No parcel greenhouse-gas value is inferred from modelled national quarterly estimates.

packages.title: NAEI Greenhouse Gas Emissions Data — scope and status QA
facts: The National Atmospheric Emissions Inventory greenhouse-gas data page was last updated on 9 June 2026.
It lists the 2026 UK Greenhouse Gas Inventory covering 1990 to 2024 and related pivot-table products.
The page also lists product years and next-publication timing for point-source, gridded and local-authority products.
Product availability and publication year must be preserved rather than assuming a listed future product is already available.
No parcel greenhouse-gas value is inferred from the national inventory catalogue.

packages.title: UK local authority and regional greenhouse gas emissions statistics — scope and status QA
facts: The DESNZ local-authority and regional greenhouse-gas statistics collection was last updated on 25 June 2026.
The collection provides consistent local and regional estimates using nationally available datasets going back to 2005.
It covers territorial carbon dioxide, methane and nitrous oxide but not fluorinated gases.
Local-authority estimates are geographic inventory estimates and are not direct measurements of individual cadastral parcels.
No parcel value is inferred from local-authority totals.
